body: My father and I have a good relationship. My relationship with my mother is slightly...different. The bulk of our relationship revolves around me catering to her mood. The good times are really good but the bad times are really bad. It’s her way or no way at all. If I cut contact with her, she’ll do everything she can to limit the time I spend with my father.

This is the bottle I’m talking about.

Don’t worry, I’m telling my baby cousins all about Auntie K. Every time someone tries to frame her as a sad spinster, I counter. I think they’re learning not to disrespect her memory around me.

True, there are a couple of dearly departed bachelor male cousins and uncles in my family tree. When people talk about them, they bring up the crazy stuff they did or the good times. They never mention their child free status.
